name: AI (Artificial Intelligence) (Drupal contrib)
loc: PHP about 92k lines and JS about 21k lines outside tests, 14 submodules; fetch.mjs prunes it (manifest `prune`) to about 95k lines: core src/, assets, config, templates and seven submodules, five with fixes and two without (ai_assistant_api, ai_observability), tests and the bundled deepchat.bundle.js removed
note: Public releases fetched by benchmark/real/fetch.mjs, never vendored. 1.5.1 is the vulnerable target, 1.5.2 the fixed control. The eight advisories of 2026-10-28 (SA-CONTRIB-2026-266 to 273) were fixed in commits with neutral titles (git.drupalcode.org compare 1.5.1...1.5.2): 7d0a6cda tooltip, 546e16aa deepchat block, c1411e30 Markdown links and stream hold (plus the backslash hunk in isUrlAllowed), 8581438d plain-text URLs and protocol-relative hosts, 13bbda76 HTMX attributes, 4aa3779d AI Search results, 25d9a125 speech-to-text, 58e9238c automators. Which commit fixes which advisory is inferred from the advisory text and the diff, not stated by the maintainers; the `why` of each key entry says so. a93f325e (api_explorer output files) and 3f3be8ca (ai_ckeditor term access) look like security fixes without an advisory and are known extras. The release ships `.agents/skills/` (also in two submodules), which fetch.mjs removes. Every contender audits the same pruned tree with no path list in the prompt; the two untouched submodules are there so the tree itself is not a hint. SA-270's cache lives in search_api, which is not in the tarball: report it apart from the other seven.
